name: Bandhani
description: Bandhani tie-dots: a dyed cloth pricked with rosettes of small pale resist dots, each with the dark knot of its tie at the center.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); @even { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: @var(--holes8); mask: @var(--holes8); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--knots8); mask: @var(--knots8); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @odd { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: @var(--holes4); mask: @var(--holes4); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--knots4); mask: @var(--knots4); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --holes8: radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 81% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 71.9% 71.9%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 81%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 28.1% 71.9%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 19% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 28.1% 28.1%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 19%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 71.9% 28.1%, transparent 70%, #000 100%); --knots8: radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 81% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 71.9% 71.9%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 81%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 28.1% 71.9%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 19% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 28.1% 28.1%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 19%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 71.9% 28.1%, #000 50%, transparent 100%); --holes4: radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 22%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 78% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 50% 78%, transparent 70%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7% 7% at 22% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 100%); --knots4: radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 22%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 78% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 50% 78%, #000 50%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2% 2% at 22% 50%, #000 50%, transparent 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
